core_meaning.primary_meaning: Anas corresponds to the Arabic form أنس and is glossed in this record as “Sociability, friendliness.” The record associates the form with root أ ن س (ʾ-n-s). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Anas corresponds to the Arabic form أنس (Arabic root أ ن س (ʾ-n-s); أَنَس (ʾanas)). Its core sense is sociability; friendliness. Anas is Arabic أَنَس (ʾanas) 'Sociability, friendliness', the verbal noun of أَنِسَ (ʾanisa, 'to be sociable, to be friendly') built on the root أ ن س (ʾ-n-s).

etymology.morphology: Verbal noun (maṣdar) from أَنِسَ (ʾanisa, 'to be sociable, to be friendly'), built on the root أ ن س.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root أ ن س (ʾ-n-s)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form أنس is an established Arabic lexical item — the verbal noun of the root أ ن س — and Anas is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: أنس
persian.long_meaning: Anas (أنس) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن انس، دوستی، الفت است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: अनस
